items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels underwent imaging Monday and will consult experts over next few days per team protocol. Marcus Mariota expected to start Sunday vs Seattle.
items.why: Dislocated left elbow (recurring); no fracture initially, more tests.
items.implication: Daniels likely out multiple weeks given history; Mariota starts, Commanders pass game and run threat downgraded significantly.

items.text: Bears HC Ben Johnson said Caleb Williams is week-to-week with a hamstring pull after MRI; expectation he will likely miss some time. Same left hamstring he injured in college vs Utah Dec 2022. Tyson Bagent is the backup.
items.why: Coach comments post-MRI; history of same injury.
items.implication: Likely out at least Week 3 MNF vs PHI; Bagent starts, pass-catchers (Moore, Odunze, Loveland, Burden) remain viable but ceiling capped.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE. RJ Harvey inactive. If you ignored me in preseason, grab Jonah Coleman now.
items.why: Official inactive list confirmation; ETR projected McConkey in with docks, Harvey doubtful.
items.implication: McConkey start with injury risk (flak jacket); Harvey out opens Coleman/backfield work. Reverse any Harvey beneficiaries.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed injured his back Sunday. Spent night in NJ, returning to GB; team evaluating best treatment and recovery timeframe.
items.why: Source report on back injury severity TBD.
items.implication: Potential multi-week absence; elevates Christian Watson and other GB WRs short-term.

items.text: Bucky Irving separating from Kenny Gainwell nicely. Out-snapped 51-23, carries 17-2, routes 22-12 yesterday. Through two weeks opportunities Bucky 36 vs Gainwell 12. Sean Tucker active but 0 offensive snaps.
items.implication: Irving locked as lead back; strong RB2/flex with every-down role. Fade Gainwell.
items.opportunity: Snaps 51, carries 17, routes 22; 36 opp thru 2 wks

items.text: Rhamondre Stevenson lost another fumble (7th in last 31 games) and was punished with playing time. NE weapon-deficient offense needs TreVeyon Henderson’s explosiveness often, even without fumbles, especially with AJ Brown out.
items.why: Fumble punishment + team need for explosiveness while Brown out.
items.implication: Henderson role expansion likely; Stevenson less secure. Henderson stash/start candidate.

items.text: DeVonta Smith target shares 27% and 38% first two games; leading all WRs in expected PPR points. RIDE. OR. DIE.
items.why: Elite target share and expected points model lead.
items.implication: Must-start WR1/2; high floor/ceiling while volume persists.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley will have MRI today after stinger; hope it is minor. He did play through it.
items.why: Stinger, played through, postgame 'I'm alright'; MRI precautionary.
items.implication: Likely available Week 3; monitor volume if limited. Handcuffs Bigsby/Shipley saw work but temporary.

items.text: 49ers HC Kyle Shanahan said he did not believe WR Mike Evans’ hip injury was serious; could have returned in Q4 if needed. Demarcus Robinson suffered high ankle sprain.
items.why: Coach comments; not expected serious per ETR watchlist too.
items.implication: Evans should be fine ROS/Week 3; Robinson out longer creates more targets for Evans/Kittle/others.

items.text: Sunday FantasyFootball injuries watching: Caleb Williams (ham), Jayden Daniels (dislocated L elbow), Saquon Barkley (stinger), Jadarian Price (chest), Jayden Reed (head), Jonathon Brooks (groin), Rico Dowdle (toe), Aaron Jones (knee), JK Dobbins (ham), Dallas Goedert (knee), Mike Evans (hip not serious), David Njoku (knee)/Charlie Kolar (forearm), others.
items.why: Comprehensive postgame injury monitor from ETR.
items.implication: Prioritize monitoring these for Week 3 status; beneficiaries for outs (e.g. if Goedert out, Eagles TE depth; Njoku/Kolar -> Gadsden routes).

items.text: Weekend reports summary: GTD Ladd McConkey (cracked rib, optimism, flak jacket) and Puka Nacua (hip). Not expected RJ Harvey (ham). Expected Chris Olave (ham), Joe Burrow (back). OUT Zay Flowers (ham), Michael Pittman (foot).
items.why: ETR weekend report aggregation; Levitan notes McConkey projected in w/ docks, Nacua true GTD, Harvey look at Coleman, Pittman out look at Bernard.
items.implication: McConkey/Nacua monitor to kickoff; Flowers/Pittman confirmed out creates WR opportunities; Olave/Burrow clear.

items.text: Puka Nacua won’t practice second straight day (groin, different from camp psoas), questionable MNF vs Giants. Backup Whittington doubtful (quad). If Puka misses expect heavier TE (Ferguson/Parkinson) and biggest WR bump Konata Mumpfield (or Malachi Fields).
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; TE stream/upside if out. ETR also flagged true GTD.

items.text: With Jordan Mason (thumb) on IR, Vikings went full Aaron Jones: snaps 42, DeeJay Dallas 8, Demond Clairborne 2. Faces TB, MIA, NO before Mason expected return.
items.why: Mason IR clears path to near-every-down role short-term.
items.implication: Jones strong RB2 next 3 weeks; handcuff value high until Mason returns.

items.text: Marvin Harrison Jr down to 0.53 yards per route run this season. Only a few WRs worse (Johnston, Dyami Brown, Addison, etc).
items.why: Extremely poor efficiency on routes through 2 weeks.
items.implication: Concern for ceiling despite draft capital; monitor role/targets but efficiency red flag for start/sit and trade value.
